title: Aegon's Landing
description: Aegon Targaryen and his sisters Visenya and Rhaenys land at the mouth of the Blackwater Rush with their three dragons — Balerion, Vhagar and Meraxes.

title: The Field of Fire
description: All three Targaryen dragons burn the combined armies of House Lannister and House Gardener. Over four thousand men perish. House Gardener is extinguished forever.

title: Aegon's Coronation
description: Aegon I Targaryen is crowned the first King of the Seven Kingdoms at the Starry Sept of Oldtown by the High Septon.

title: Fall of Meraxes in Dorne
description: Queen Rhaenys Targaryen and her dragon Meraxes are brought down over the Hellholt by a Dornish scorpion bolt. Rhaenys is captured and later dies in Dornish captivity.

title: Death of Aegon I
description: Aegon the Conqueror dies at Dragonstone from a stroke at the age of sixty-three, while telling his grandsons tales of his conquest at the Painted Table. Aenys I inherits the throne.

title: Maegor the Cruel seizes the throne
description: Maegor I Targaryen seizes the Iron Throne upon the death of his brother Aenys I, bypassing Aenys's rightful heir. His six-year reign is defined by cruelty, religious persecution and dragon fire.

title: Jaehaerys I takes the throne
description: Jaehaerys Targaryen claims the throne after Maegor the Cruel is found dead on the Iron Throne. Begins the longest and most prosperous reign in Targaryen history — 55 years.

title: Death of Jaehaerys I — Viserys I crowned
description: The Old King dies after 55 years on the throne. A Great Council had chosen his grandson Viserys I over Rhaenys Targaryen as his successor — a decision that would later fuel the Dance of the Dragons.

title: Dance of the Dragons begins
description: King Viserys I dies. His son Aegon II is crowned by the Greens, bypassing Viserys's named heir Rhaenyra Targaryen. Civil war erupts between the Blacks and the Greens.

title: The Storming of the Dragonpit
description: A mob storms the Dragonpit in King's Landing, slaying the dragons Shrykos, Morghul, Tyraxes, Dreamfyre and Syrax. Queen Helaena Targaryen throws herself from her window upon hearing the news.

title: Dance of the Dragons ends
description: Aegon II is poisoned by his own council. Rhaenyra had already been fed to Sunfyre. The war ends with House Targaryen devastated and their dragons nearly extinct. Aegon III takes the throne.

title: Robert's Rebellion begins
description: Prince Rhaegar Targaryen abducts — or elopes with — Lyanna Stark. Her father Rickard and brother Brandon are burned alive by the Mad King Aerys II. Eddard Stark, Robert Baratheon and Jon Arryn raise their banners in rebellion.

title: The Trident and the Sack of King's Landing
description: Robert Baratheon kills Prince Rhaegar at the Battle of the Trident. Tywin Lannister sacks King's Landing. Jaime Lannister kills the Mad King Aerys II. Robert Baratheon takes the Iron Throne.

title: Death of King Robert Baratheon
description: King Robert Baratheon dies from a hunting wound inflicted by a boar. Joffrey Baratheon ascends the Iron Throne, secretly the son of Cersei and Jaime Lannister.

title: Birth of the Dragons
description: Daenerys Targaryen hatches three dragon eggs on Khal Drogo's funeral pyre on the Dothraki Sea. Dragons return to the world for the first time in over 150 years.

title: The Red Wedding
description: Robb Stark, his mother Catelyn, and most of his army are massacred at the Twins during the wedding feast of Edmure Tully. Guest right is violated by House Frey and House Bolton.

title: Battle of the Blackwater
description: Stannis Baratheon's fleet attacks King's Landing by sea. Tyrion Lannister's wildfire chain destroys much of the fleet. Tywin Lannister arrives with the Tyrell army to rout Stannis's forces.

title: The Long Night returns — Wall breached
description: The Night King reanimates the dragon Viserion and destroys the Wall at Eastwatch-by-the-Sea. The Army of the Dead marches south into Westeros.

title: Battle of Winterfell
description: The living face the dead at Winterfell in the longest night in living memory. Arya Stark kills the Night King with a Valyrian steel dagger, ending the Long Night and destroying the entire Army of the Dead.

title: The Burning of King's Landing
description: Daenerys Targaryen burns King's Landing with Drogon despite the city's surrender, killing thousands of civilians. She is later killed by Jon Snow in the throne room. Bran Stark is chosen as King of the Six Kingdoms.
